text: I really love Moonlight Diner. It's a late night diner that just feels really good to walk in. You just get that neon glow and the smell of bacon and coffee and it's just amazing. It's a very simple menu, just fries, pancakes, club sandwiches. The club sandwich is great. The service is just very good and quick and they're very patient even at 2 or 3 a.m. when it's really packed with night people and just people that are tired of traveling. The booths are very clean and spacious and there's a jukebox that plays very nice old songs. Bottomless coffee. The milkshakes are very very thick, thick enough to keep a spoon up. The apple pie is really good, very flaky and very nice. The only drawback is that sometimes it's very noisy and on the weekends it's really hard to get a table. Some of the food is very greasy but that's the charm I guess. And there's not a lot of parking. But overall, I really recommend it for very hearty food. Very generous portions. Just very nice and pleasant atmosphere late at night. So I recommend everybody come hungry and leave full and have the pie.
